ja: • 月を誘いし伝説のポケモン「ルナアーラ」登場！
• 首と尻尾の可動で「迫力の飛行ポーズ」を、胴体部と翼幕の二軸の可動で「優雅な羽ばたきポーズ」を再現。
• どちらのポーズでも飾れる台座が付属。
成形品×3、シール×1、組立説明書×1
en: • The neck and tail can be moved to create a powerful flight pose, and the body and wing curtains can be moved in two axes to create an elegant flapping pose.
• Comes with a pedestal that can be displayed in either pose.
Molded product x 3, Seal x 1, Assembly manual x 1
